verdict.rationale: mise's registry backs onto asdf plugins, aqua, GitHub releases, npm, PyPI/pipx, cargo, go, vfox, and its own Homebrew implementation, giving access to a very large and actively maintained set of installable tools, with community reports corroborating broad language/tool coverage (node, ruby, python, java, uv, rust, etc.). missing for 10: no independent registry-size/freshness metrics or third-party audit of package registry maintenance cadence beyond docs and anecdotal HN comments.
